containers.name: task
command:
set -euo pipefail
python -m pip install --quiet --no-deps uv==0.10.7
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/bundle/source.tar.gz')
assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'f387ee88086c867288d64043f4f905c4816f97d665fb0f3768249acc94dcc363'
with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
    archive.extractall('/app', filter='data')
PY
cd /app
exec bash bootstrap.sh --recover --regional --region RNO2A "$@"
